premises.text: Customers face inefficiencies in finding last-minute personal services.
premises.evidence_span: it seemed really inefficient that I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Merchants are willing to accept customers on their own terms.
premises.evidence_span: there's a pool of highly qualified small businesses that are willing to bend over backwards in order to bring a new customer through the door

premises.text: Bidzee allows customers to name their own price for services.
premises.evidence_span: you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants can monetize idle time by accepting bids.
premises.evidence_span: allowing them to monetize otherwise idle time

premises.text: Merchants face challenges with existing customer acquisition channels.
premises.evidence_span: their consistent feedback about their available channels of customer acquisition was pretty simple. Firstly, they were too expensive, or they were too complicated to set up.

premises.text: Bidzee provides certainty and immediacy for merchants regarding customer appointments.
premises.evidence_span: they have certainty and immediacy of when the service is expected

premises.text: Bidzee connects customers with verified local businesses.
premises.evidence_span: Bidzee is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

value.text: Customers receive services on their terms while merchants gain paying customers.
value.evidence_span: we give customers the deals and the services that they want on their terms and we allow merchants to bring more money through their door

notes: No separate premises for the unique marketplace model as it encompasses multiple claims.
